import pytz

traces_path = telemetry.get_traces()
trace_df = pd.read_csv(traces_path) if traces_path else pd.DataFrame()

# Convert timestamp to datetime with UTC+8 timezone
tz = pytz.timezone('Asia/Shanghai')
trace_df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(trace_df['timestamp'], unit='s').dt.tz_localize('UTC').dt.tz_convert(tz)

# Define the time window for filtering
start_time = tz.localize(pd.Timestamp('2021-03-04 18:00:00'))
end_time = tz.localize(pd.Timestamp('2021-03-04 18:30:00'))

# Filter traces within the time window
filtered_traces = trace_df[(trace_df['datetime'] >= start_time) & (trace_df['datetime'] <= end_time)]

# Summarize by counting traces per component (cmdb_id)
trace_counts = filtered_traces.groupby('cmdb_id').size().reset_index(name='trace_count').sort_values(by='trace_count', ascending=False)
